# CodePlay Studios

> CodePlay Studios is a software studio that builds AI-powered business systems, web applications, mobile apps, ERP suites, and Unity games. We deliver scalable, intelligent software tailored to each client's needs.

CodePlay Studios is based in Panadura, Sri Lanka, and works with clients worldwide. This file points language models to the canonical pages describing our services, work, and editorial content.

Contact: info@codeplaystudios.com

## Services

- [Web Development](https://codeplaystudios.com/web-development): Robust, scalable, responsive web applications.
- [Mobile Development](https://codeplaystudios.com/mobile-development): Native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android.
- [AI Development](https://codeplaystudios.com/ai-development): AI integration, automation, and intelligent business systems.
- [ERP Systems](https://codeplaystudios.com/erp-systems): Custom ERP suites and internal business platforms.
- [Unity Game Development](https://codeplaystudios.com/unity-game-development): Games and interactive 3D experiences built with Unity.
